messages:
lina-ux: Quick thread: proposing a 'compact' left rail mode (icons + tooltips) as an opt-in for power users. Need to confirm deep-link behavior, breadcrumbs, and copy for the copy-link toast. Also noticed back-button oddness when toggling compact mode.
omar-fe: Compact mode should be visual-only. We shouldn't touch history on toggle. The weirdness is from a helper that writes a collapsed state to history.replaceState for analytics. I'll remove that.
zoe-a11y: Accessibility: compact visual collapse must not change tab order. Tooltips need accessible names (aria-label) and keyboard users need an easily reachable 'Expand nav' control. For deep links, focus goes to panel heading and we should announce via live region.
kevin-prod: Product note: copy for the nav item should be 'Projects' and tooltip: "Projects 1 your team workspaces". For copy-to-clipboard deep links, microcopy should say: "Link copied 1 opens Logs at line 204".
lina-ux: Breadcrumbs: prefer chevron separators (>) and no trailing slash. When in compact mode show a condensed breadcrumb (ProjectName > Panel) above the content.
omar-fe: Router snippet I'll use:
```
// canonical deep link
/app/:org/projects/:id?panel=logs&anchor=line-204
// nav toggles: CSS-only, NO history mutation
// route changes: history.pushState
```
Also will ensure analytics uses a non-history side channel.
zoe-a11y: Small nit: if a deep link includes an anchor we must scroll to target BEFORE announcing, otherwise SRs read the wrong context. Add a short micro-delay: detect fragment -> scroll -> set focus -> announce.
navbot: ci: nav-compact-branch e2e job #701 failed: deep-link-announce flake. See https://ci.example/701 :x:
omar-fe: I'll add an e2e test that navigates to a fragment, waits for element visible, then checks aria-live message. Will open PR and ping for a11y review.
lina-ux: OK locking on compact visual mode (no-history), panel query param routing, fragment-first scroll then announce, 'Projects' label, and the toast microcopy. Thanks all :sparkles:
